54/S0.subgoal: Explain what resources mean in XR, why resource optimization is needed, and why this lecture focuses on client-side hardware.

54/S1.subgoal: Explain why understanding computer graphics is needed for VR resource optimization and describe the basic problem of image representation and synthesis.

54/S2.subgoal: Describe the major components of a generic graphics system and how they work together to render an image.

54/S3.subgoal: Compare vector scan and raster scan display mechanisms and explain why raster scan dominates commercial displays.

54/S4.subgoal: Explain how raster scan displays store, refresh, and create color image data using frame buffer, periodic refreshing, and RGB pixel elements.

54/S5.subgoal: Summarize the lecture's main points and preview the 3D graphics pipeline.
